scheme_name: Maternity Assistance for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: Must have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year
Benefits limited to the first two children of the applicant
Applicant must be a registered women member or the wife of a registered male member of the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
benefits_summary: A cash assistance of ₹30,000 per eligible woman member or wife for up to two children.
